prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fashion surrealist advertising poster for Crocs. The scene is set in a minimalist monochrome light-blue studio with a semi-reflective floor. The central focus is an oversized giant white Crocs clog positioned on its heel at a diagonal angle, serving as a backrest. An adult woman fashion model with long dark hair, dressed in a clean all-white coordinated sweatshirt and wide-leg trousers, leans her entire back against the giant shoe in a relaxed posture, facing right in profile with a serene expression and wearing standard-sized white Crocs. In the background, the word "CROCS" is written in massive bold white condensed sans-serif typography, partially occluded by the giant shoe and model. At top right, "Designed with ChatGPT". At bottom center, an approved white sans-serif comfort tagline. Soft cool even lighting casts gentle shadows and a soft reflection on the glossy blue floor. Overall aesthetic is clean, modern and high-concept. Aspect ratio 3:4.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, warped clog, floating model, illegible logo, broken reflections
